import pylbmisc as lb
from pylbmisc import io2 as io
from pylbmisc.r import *
from functools import partial
testing = lb.utils.is_interactive()
dfs = io.import("tmp/dfs.pkl")
def Table(*args, **kwargs):
    return lb.stats.Table(*args, xdes=dfs["vd"][args[1]], ydes=dfs["vd"][args[2]], **kwargs)
Tables = partial(lb.stats.Tables, vars_des=dfs["vd"])
# exported_tab = dict() # output tables
